text:
Supply order for Ellmere depot.
Personnel: Bram, Dell, Greta, Jonah, Pia, Leon, Cora, Mira, Suri, Nils, Una, Vik, Teo, Hugo, Rafe, Wren, Kira, Ines, Ada, Opal, Finn, Esme. Finn out; Wren covering. Cora/Una swapping desks. Hugo/Finn swapping desks. Greta/Ines swapping desks. Jonah/Nils swapping desks.
Issues: Lifts near loading bay, east wing, north office, print room, library annex, garden studio, harbour room are slow. East wing, garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, north office, library annex too cold. Garden studio too cold in afternoon. Wren thinks loading bay too cold in evening. Garden studio too cold in afternoon. East wing, garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, print room, library annex being repainted (noise). Umbrellas in loading bay, garden studio, north office.
Order items: 515 crates; 400 ladders.
Notes: Finn, Mira, Teo, Suri, Opal, Esme want north office/loading bay/garden studio/print room clear for visitors. Nils, Hugo, Leon also want specific areas clear. Ines, Leon, Rafe, Una, Dell, Ada prefer specific rooms for reviews. Wren prefers harbour room for reviews. Bram prefers loading bay/library annex. Coffee machines in north office, library annex, loading bay working. North office coffee machine working again. Print room coffee machine working again. Morning stand-up moved to loading bay. Afternoon stand-up moved to print room. Print room being repainted (noise). User needs to send Esme, Mira, Opal, Vik, Kira morning meeting notes; Jonah afternoon notes. Assistant offered to draft note to Greta. Check with Kira/Hugo before morning meeting; Leon before afternoon meeting. User must send Hugo morning meeting notes. North office lift is slow today. User must send Cora evening meeting notes. User must send Kira evening meeting notes. User needs to send Opal afternoon meeting notes. Mira asked if east wing is free in afternoon. Rafe asked if north office is free in afternoon. Rafe thinks north office too cold in evening. Library annex being repainted (noise morning/evening). Harbour room being repainted (noise afternoon).
